int.precisa.ads:
1. Spraytec USA gives Cancha's Business Manager partner access to the US ad account.
2. Cancha adds the account to the portal's system user and generates the key (META_TOKEN), which lives only on the server.
3. On the server, set META_CONTA_ANUNCIOS to the US account number (the portal never uses the Brazil one).
int.precisa.ig: Same Meta key. Spraytec USA gives partner access to the “Spraytec” page and its linked Instagram. On the server, set META_PAGINA_ID to the US page ID.
int.precisa.fb: Together with Instagram (same page, same key).
int.precisa.gads: Account 378-993-7807 is already under Cancha's MCC (223-025-0690). Still needed: the MCC developer token and the credential of the Google Cloud project approved with it (GOOGLE_ADS_TOKEN_DEV and GOOGLE_ADS_CLIENT_ID/SECRET), with this portal's return address authorized. int.precisa.ga4: A Google Cloud OAuth client (GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID/SECRET) with this portal's return address, plus the DRIVE_CHAVE key generated on the server. Then click “Connect” with a Google login that sees the spraytecusa.com GA4 property and set GA4_PROPRIEDADE.
